description.en: Jev-judged context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: semantic tool-result pruning + deterministic receipt compaction
Prompt Presets to manage your library
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用提示词库，一键注入到输入框，快速复用你的提示词模板。

description.en: DSH plugin: browse & live-sync local Claude Code / Codex CLI / Cursor Agent conversations inside the dsh web GUI
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面里直接浏览并实时同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor Agent 的本地对话记录，方便统一查看和管理。

description.en: DSH plugin: sync MCP configs from Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent
description.zh: 一键同步 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor 的 MCP 配置，省去手动迁移的麻烦。

description.en: DSH plugin: auto-upload conversation progress to Tencent IMA (daily note + Work knowledge base)
description.zh: 自动把对话记录同步到腾讯IMA，自动生成每日笔记和工作知识库，方便随时查阅和知识沉淀。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按需技能工具：注册 skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref 三个工具，让模型先从分层的技能库里检索、再按需加载正文，库里的技能因而不必进入常驻目录、不占每轮上下文；并在对话视图栏加一个「技能」标签页，回读整个会话、列出本次真正加载过哪些技能及其轮次。零依赖，所有技能调用记录只在客户端渲染，不进入模型上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage tools for DeepSeek Harness
